title: Word of yesterday's ruling
body:
Shahbandar, the whole waterfront has heard of yesterday's ruling. The temenggung's men say it was well done. The merchants say it more quietly.

Honest captains are glad: a port that catches false declarations protects their prices. Others will be more careful with their papers, and some will be more careful to hide what they carry.

Warning: your name is now known in the anchorage. Expect better manifests, and better lies.
notes: The player is a shahbandar; port-wide berthing and inspection authority is a game abstraction; customs rulings are made in the temenggung's name.
Requires flag major_fraud_ruled_yesterday: a Major Fraud ruling was proven correct the previous day.
